facts.fact: IOM's IATI record shows a USD 300,000 project, in implementation from 2026-10-01 to 2028-09-30, supporting Malawi's National Statistical Office and government institutions with harmonized administrative data standards for migration data.
facts.system: Strengthening Migration Data Governance for Evidence-Based Policymaking in Malawi

MWI.note: The document mentions censuses only as past sources of migration data; no census or survey is stated as taken, prepared or published.

systems.country_label: Migration data governance framework (planned, IOM project)

MWI.note: Only a migration-specific data governance framework is planned under a project; no national data policy is stated.
